svg.title: Why template 3.1 needs an analytic inverse
svg.desc: Two panels. Left, a schematic globe: the true graticule in solid strokes, the rotated graticule in dashed strokes, the rotated south pole marked at -36.0885°, -114.6949°, and the HRDPS continental domain lying along the rotated equator. Right, the neighbourhood of the launch at 49.3634°, -117.2361°: dashed rotated gridlines at 0.0225° spacing tilted against the solid true graticule, the launch mapped by toRotated to rotated (-4.5183°, -1.6599°), fractional cell (584.95, 345.96), nearest gridpoint (i 585, j 346) = storage index 879425, with the 0.156 km residual drawn in a magnified inset.
